Language Movement veteran Abdul Kayum passes away
2018-07-30T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Dinajpur
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/language-movement-veteran-abdul-kayum-passes-away-1613149

Abdul Kayum, a Language Movement veteran, and an income tax lawyer of Dinajpur, passed away at his home yesterday, aged 85.

He left behind two sons, three daughters and grandchildren to mourn his death.

He was buried at Suihari graveyard in Dinajpur town.
